settings.title: Peach Sherry Cobbler
settings.ingredients:
2 oz Peach Daytrip
1.5 oz Amontillado sherry
Muddled orange
settings.method: Add 2 slices of orange to a shaker tin and muddle. Add Daytrip and sherry with ice. Shake to combine. Pour over a glass with ice. Garnish with lots of fresh fruit.

settings.title: Peach Arnold Palmer
settings.method: Build in a Collins glass with ice. Stir to combine.

settings.title: Peach Julep
settings.method: Add ingredients to a glass and muddle mint. Top with plenty of crushed ice. Garnish with mint and sliced peach.

settings.description: A peach wine-based amaro that keeps the orchard close. Real Brieremere peaches meet rich marzipan notes from distilled peach leaves, delicate rose and elderflower, and a touch of pink peppercorn. Gently bitter and softly sweet, with peach at the heart of every pour.
settings.quote_alt: “The Amaro I’ll be drinking all summer” — Sam Stone, Bon Appétit
settings.fact_copy: Wine-based amaro made with real fruit and botanicals
settings.callout_alt: Add some fizz, shake it with berries, or stir up something fresh with gin and mint.
